svg.text: SECTION A-A ON THE CENTRE LINE, 1:8
The battery (11) is in front of the cut: see the view on the open hatch.
VIEW ON THE OPEN HATCH, LID OFF, 1:5
3 x 20 W panels (29) → MPPT charger in the control unit (13)
→ LiFePO4 12.8 V 40 Ah battery (11) → 12 V to:
• LED lantern (30), flashing at night only
Cables pass through glands (17) in the lid; none through the hull.
Needed 9.4 Wh a day; panels make 19.5 Wh in December
(2.1 x more); the battery alone lasts 44 days.
Third angle projection. Drawn from the CAD model with hidden line removal.
